property_summary: For any spender and any subtractedValue, if the caller's pre-call allowance is at least subtractedValue then decreaseAllowance must succeed and set the allowance to pre - subtractedValue; the mutant omits the guard so an underflow reverts with a panic instead of reverting cleanly/returning true, and for admissible (non-underflowing) inputs the post-allowance still differs because the reference reverts with '!approval' while the mutant succeeds.
change_summary: Delete the require guard so that underflow in currentAllowance - subtractedValue reverts with a panic instead of the guard's custom error message for insufficient allowance.
